title: Before we compute
learning_goal: Leave with the questions to bring to the supervisors before any computing, ranked by what each answer unblocks, each tied to the scene that raised it.
takeaway: Every bet on the staircase hangs on decisions due before the first run; the cheapest experiment is a good question asked before renting a graphics card.
notes: New unit (BRIEF section 3.3), both cuts, before ch11. PLACEMENT: tools/assemble_cut.py already places ch10q before ch11 (EXTRA_UNITS) in both cuts; insert_after is informational: {'core': 'ch10.Q', 'extended': 'X5b.Q'}. In the core cut ch10's last scene is ch10.Q (10.9-bridge is extended-only); in the extended cut the modules anchored inside ch10 (X6 after 10.9-bridge, X5b after X6) are inserted before ch10q, so ch10q follows X5b.Q (checked by assembling both cuts into a scratch folder). SHAPE: six scenes, about 2 min 50 s (≈ 171 s at the assembler's estimate, 367 words; the continuity budget was 150 s: the trim option of continuity.md section 6, 'ch10q at 2 min', would drop 10q.5's spoken list and keep its board). 10q.1 recaps the bets as a staircase of decisions (every register question hangs under the step it shapes); 10q.2-10q.4 the first shelf, priority 1, by category a, b, c (13 questions, each focused with a callback thumbnail of the scene that raised it); 10q.5 shelves 2 and 3 (17 questions, four spoken); 10q.6 the first shelf as one message to write before renting, the ranking flagged as a proposal, the closing line, then the handover frame of 11.1. ORDER: the board follows order_for_ch10q exactly (priority, then category a, b, c, then register order); narration groups Q17 with Q24 (run length near a threshold) and Q8 with Q16 (statistics, topology included). REGISTER: params.board of 10q.1 mirrors script/_shared/question_register.json (ids, category, priority, card or ask, extended-only flag); labels of at most 28 characters are this unit's short forms of the register's texts; the register wins on any difference and the builder writes the board once in scenes/ch10q/board.js. Q15: the label 'Positioning the first paper?' follows the register; script/chSOA2.json (written in parallel) currently carries a different chSOA2.Q (LATU grid or SFEMaNS mesh, n null): the consistency editor reconciles, then the label follows. NARRATION: questions are spoken only when both cuts motivate them (Q17's callback is 10.4, Q19's is 03.5 and the report's question 2, Q21's is 10.2); cards and ask boxes that play only in the extended cut (Q11, Q12, Q14, Q16, Q17, Q19, Q20; Q21, Q27, Q28, Q29, Q30) get a double outline and a legend, so the visual is the same in both cuts (a scene does not know its cut). The question cards' numbers are never spoken. No digits, no parentheses, no 'GPU' in narration ('graphics card'; no lexicon entry exists for GPU); 'Jean Zay', 'Pm', 'Reynolds' are pinned in audio/lexicon.json. NO QUESTION CARD: the chapter is the register; a ch10q.Q would repeat a card or add a 31st question; deviation from BRIEF 3.1 to confirm by the lead, as for ch11 (the film's last card stays ch10.Q in the core cut and X5b.Q in the extended cut; 10q.1 opens right after it and 11.1 follows 10q.6). LEVELS: the chapter card steps down from L5 to L4 (declared side-step, rail tag 'step back: the questions', as 10.1's), 10q.4 is L3 (logistics, no physics) with music false so that the chapter stays silent until the bed returns in 11.2, and the unit ends at L4. EDIT IN ch11 (minimal, this pass): 11.1's chapter card levelFrom 'L5' -> 'L4' (the rail climbs back to L5 for the two-column recap, then descends in 11.2) and its visual sentence on the rail; its narration is unchanged: 'Questions first, then computing. Here is what those questions rest on' follows 10q.6's last line, and 10q.6 ends on the three category tickets that 11.1 fans in at 'first'. This replaces the continuity note 'ch10q should end at L5' (the lead's brief for this unit asked L3-L4). BADGES: PLANNED for the bets and the configured campaigns (10q.1-10q.3), CONJECTURE medium for the logistics claim (renting shrinks to a trial only if the repository, never run on a graphics card, works as designed on lab GPUs or Jean Zay), for the ranking (10q.5) and for the closing claim (10q.6). DATA: none (deps empty, all scenes ready); no number on screen except ticket numbers, step and bet names already used in ch10 ('BOX 64³'). THUMBNAILS: schematic redraws of earlier motifs (no data), each window headed 'CALLBACK · SCHEMATIC'; captions name chapters, never scene ids. REQUESTS. (1) Scene builder: scenes/ch10q/board.js (tickets, columns, shelves, legend, the 30 glyph drawers, reusable by the French cut since visuals stay English); keep the ticket drawing consistent with Kit.questionCard (notch, mono number). (2) Consistency editor: add ch10q to continuity.md sections 1, 2, 5, 6 (levels, ≈ 2.7 min), and decide the chapter number ('ASK'). (3) French sheet: ch10q introduces no new question.

sentences.text: Every chapter so far has ended on a question.
The empty seats raised more.
Hang each one under the step it shapes.
Bet one: whether to add settings between seventeen and eighteen.
Bet two: the {b}seed{/}, the {param}Reynolds number{/}, the length of each run.
The {model}generator{/}: what it must match.
The top steps: the partners' data.
A staircase of bets is a staircase of decisions, and the first ones come before any run.

scenes.visual: Render class flat (DOM/SVG). No data file: the 30 tickets come from params.board (a mirror of the question register, in order_for_ch10q), written once in scenes/ch10q/board.js and shared by the six scenes (params.board_note). Ticket: params.ticket (80 x 40, --panel fill, a half-moon notch on its left edge, the number in JetBrains Mono 28, e.g. 'Q7'); outline solid for a question card, dashed for a register-only ask (kind 'seat'), double for a ticket whose card or ask box plays only in the extended cut (ext: true; the same drawing in both cuts, explained by the legend in 10q.5). LEAD-IN (3.2 s, no voice): Kit.chapterCard(ctx, params.chapter_card): 'CHAPTER ASK', title 'Before we compute', staircase with tier 1 lit and tiers 2-4 dashed (as 11.1), and the rail M8 stepping DOWN from L5 to L4 with the tag 'step back: the questions' (a declared side-step like 10.1's: the scene before, ch10.Q in the core cut and X5b.Q in the extended cut, is at L5); whoosh at 0.1. P1. On 'cards-0.15': the 20 card tickets (kind 'card' or 'planned', Q1-Q20) deal in as a loose fan at the centre of the frame (y 300-620), 0.04 s apart, in number order. On 'seats-0.15': ten small grey dashed frames (the seats' 'ASK BEFORE WE COMPUTE' box in miniature) blink in along the bottom of the fan; out of each slides a dashed register-only ticket (Q21-Q30) that joins the fan, and the frame fades. P2. On 'stairs-0.15': T1 morph: the fan lifts to the top edge while the staircase M7 draws large (Kit.staircase in params.staircase.box; labels exactly as in 03.7 and 10.1; steps 0-1 lit, step 2 at 40 % with a dashed outline, steps 2-4 dashed, each with the small grey BET seat icon of 10.1); step 2 splits into three bet slots labelled in mono 28 'BET 1 · BOX 64³', 'BET 2 · TAYLOR–GREEN', '3D GENERATOR'. Then every ticket flies (0.03 s apart, 0.6 s each) to its hook (ticket.hook, params.hooks) and hangs under that step's base on a short grey string (params.hang): columns of 80-px tickets, 8 px apart, from y 562 down, never below y 860; hook labels in mono 28 (--muted) above each column; the hook 'every' hangs at the far left, labelled 'EVERY STEP'. Soft pop at 'stairs+0.4'. Then, one hook per sentence: on 'bet1-0.15', 'bet2-0.15', 'gen-0.15' that hook's tickets brighten to --fg and swing once (about 3 degrees, critically damped), and its bet slot's dashed outline turns chalk for 1.2 s; every other ticket dims to 45 %; on 'top-0.15' the hooks of steps 3 and 4 (VKS, DRESDYN) light together. P3. On 'decisions-0.15': the BET icons of steps 2-4 turn over (a 0.5-s flip about their vertical axis) and show a small ticket glyph instead; then, on the words 'the first ones' (about 1.5 s before the sentence ends; use the sentence's end), the 13 priority-1 tickets (params.first_shelf) take a chalk outline at 100 % while the other 17 settle at 60 %: a preview of the first shelf of 10q.2; soft pop. The chip 'Independent PhD proposal · not requested or validated by the supervisors' (Kit.chip kind 'plain', top centre, y about 112) enters at 'stairs+0.8' and holds. Badge PLANNED (top-right) from 'stairs', note from the script. Idle motion: the hanging tickets sway by half a degree, out of phase. Key colours: none (greys, chalk, --fg); the thumbnails' colours wait for 10q.2. No lower-third, no formula layer, no corner needle. Music: none (L4).

scenes.visual: Render class flat. Board state A (params.layout). ON ENTRY (0.6-s lead-in, from the last frame of 10q.1): T1 morph: the staircase fades out while the tickets unhook. The 13 tickets of priority 1 fly to their rows: column by category (params.columns: a x 110-650, b x 690-1230, c x 1270-1810), row by register order (a: Q2, Q3, Q5, Q6, Q17, Q18, Q22, Q24; b: Q8, Q9, Q16; c: Q21, Q23), rows from y 204, 44 px apart. The other 17 slide into a dim stack at the bottom right (layout.later_pile, 45 %), labelled 'LATER' in mono 28. Column heads type in at y 110-150: the question card's category tags with their pictograms (cards.js CAT and GLY: 'RUNS · PARAMETERS', 'METRICS · CRITERIA', 'DATA · GPUs · BUDGET'; mono 28, --fg-2); the shelf label '1 · BEFORE RENTING' (mono 28, --fg) with its sub-line 'changes what is computed, how or where' (Inter 28, --fg-2) at y 160-192, left. Each row: the ticket, a 32-px callback icon (the ticket's glyph in miniature) and the label (Inter Medium 30, Kit.fit, never below 28), the label hidden until the row is focused; rows at 45 %. P1. On 'runs-0.15': the RUNS column head brightens, its eight rows rise to 70 %, the pen M9 underlines 'RUNS · PARAMETERS'. P2. On each cue of params.focus ('seed', 'pm', 'spread', 'snaps', 'long', 'tg', 'first', at cue-0.15): the row brightens to 100 % and its label wipes in (0.4 s); the callback window opens (layout.callback_window, x 700-1300, y 596-850, --panel fill, 1-px --grid outline, header 'CALLBACK · SCHEMATIC' in mono 28 --muted): the row's icon grows into a 300 x 160 thumbnail, a schematic redraw of the motif of the scene the question came from (ticket.glyph; no data, no number), captioned with ticket.caption in mono 28 (Kit.upper), e.g. 'CHAPTER 1 · THE SQUEAL'; a chalk leader line runs from the row's right end to the window for 1.5 s. The next focus cue cuts the thumbnail to the next one in 0.2 s (montage grammar, no crossfade). On 'long', two tickets (Q17, Q24) light together and the window splits into two 270 x 150 halves with their two captions. Focused rows stay at 100 % with their labels; the window closes at 'first+2.2' (it shrinks back into Q22's icon). Q17 keeps its double outline (extended-cut card); its callback is 10.4, which both cuts show. Badge PLANNED (top-right), note from the script. Key colours: green (the Pm ruler, the knob axes), vermillion (the seed and growth curves), never more than three in one frame; the board itself in --fg, --fg-2 and greys. Idle: the LATER stack breathes (opacity 40-48 %). Music: none (L4).
